title: Flexible Contract Schema
description: One schema for base contracts, mods, subcontract mods, and task orders. Use this as the starting Document AI schema. Add a second schema only if mods fail often.

documentType.description: Base Contract, Modification, Subcontract Mod, Task Order, NDA, MSA, SaaS, Government Contract, or Other

modNumber.description: Modification or subcontract mod number if present

effectiveDate.description: Effective date in YYYY-MM-DD if present

expirationDate.description: Expiration or end date in YYYY-MM-DD if present

clauses.description: Key clauses found in the document

clauseType.description: Liability Limitation, Indemnification, Termination, Governing Law, Confidentiality, Data Protection, Intellectual Property, Assignment, Force Majeure, Audit Rights, Limitation of Remedies, Payment Terms, Warranty, Non-Solicitation, or Other

section.description: Section or clause number if present

excerpt.description: Exact or closely matching text span
